2024
Author: Ravindra Maithani

 High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
 First Bail Application No.625 of 2024
Atul Das alias Muta .....Applicant
 Versus

entities.text: High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Present:-

Mr. Sandeep Singh Rawat, Advocate for the applicant
 through video conferencing.
Ms. Manisha Rana Singh, D.A.G. for the State.
Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)

Applicant is in judicial custody in Case Crime/FIR No. 13 of 2023, under Section 376 Ipc and
Section 5 (k) and 6 of the Protection of Children From Sexual Offences Act, 2012, Police Station
Hindolakhal, District Tehri Garhwal.

entities.text: Protection of Children From Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: He has sought his release on bail.

2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3.
According to the FIR, on 12.05.2023, the victim was in a marriage and the applicant took her in a fields and did galat kaam with her.
The victim is not mentally developed and could not speak.
She somehow indicated the incident to her mother, who lodged the FIR.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that the victim has already been examined at the trial.
She did not speak anything.
Whatever part of her statement has been recorded, the court has noted that she could not understand what is being asked to her.
It is also argued that the statement recorded under Section 164 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 ("the Code") of the victim has not been proved in the court by her.

5. Learned State counsel would submit that the interpreter has proved the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 of the Code, which, in fact, was recorded with the help of the interpreter and it was videographed.
6. It is the stage of bail.
Much of the discussion is not expected of.
Arguments are being appreciated with the caveat that any observation made in this order shall have no bearing at any subsequent stage of the trial or in any other proceedings.

1 7.

entities.text: Atul Das Alias Muta vs State Of Uttarakhand on 12 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the court, the victim was examined, but the court has stated that it is not clear as to whether the victim is able to understand the signs which are made to her and court deferred the examination-in-chief of the victim on 15.09.2023.
On the next date, her examination-in-chief was not further recorded, though, the Special Educator was present on that date.
The statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 of the Code could not be proved by the victim in the court.
8. The question is that if the victim could not be examined in the trial, how was she examined under section 164 of the Code?
This and many more question would find answer during trial.
9. Having considered the entirety of facts, this Court is of the view that the applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail.
10. The bail application is allowed.

11. Let the applicant be released on bail, on his executing a personal bond and furnishing two reliable sureties, each of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the Court concerned.
(Ravindra Maithani, J) 12.12.2024 Jitendra Atul Das Alias Muta vs State Of Uttarakhand on 12 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/56471711/
